Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Business Development Manager to join our Bristol & South West team. In this role, you’ll help us sign up the best restaurants across Bristol and the South West region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Regional UK & Ireland team, reporting to the Regional Manager. We are experts in the local markets we serve, and this role is all about being out on the road, finding hidden gems, and being the face of Deliveroo in the South West and Wales.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Strategic Prospecting: Map, prospect, pitch, and close new restaurants across your region, acting as a city-level expert who knows exactly which up-and-coming spots customers crave most.
Multi-channel Outreach: Communicate with restaurant owners through physical visits, calls, and digital platforms to demonstrate the value of Deliveroo’s technology.
Seamless Onboarding: Oversee the partner onboarding process from start to finish to ensure it is as quick, efficient, and seamless as possible.
Performance Monitoring: Ensure restaurant success within the critical first eight weeks of signing to guarantee long-term growth on the platform.
Community Immersion: Attend restaurant and food meet-ups and sample food from high-quality establishments to stay ahead of market trends.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Sales & Negotiation: Proven experience in targeting new business and the ability to structure win-win deals for both partners and Deliveroo.
Commercial Knowledge: A strong understanding of the economics of food delivery and the ability to work effectively towards demanding monthly targets.
Exceptional Communication: Confidence in building relationships face-to-face, over the phone, and via email with a wide range of stakeholders.
Operational Ownership: A tenacious, self-motivated approach to managing your own territory and taking full ownership of your results.
Mobility: A valid driving licence and access to a car are required, as you will be frequently travelling across Bristol and the surrounding areas.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Make a visible impact every day
Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment
Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
🧠 Build a career, not just a role
Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture
Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here .
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.
For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.
AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience.

But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.
We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.
Check out our principles to see how we work.

==============================
Wir machen Medienmachende. Das MAZ ist das führende Kompetenzzentrum für Journalismus und Kommunikation direkt beim Bahnhof Luzern. Als Stiftung unterstützt durch verschiedene namhafte Träger im Medienbereich sorgen wir für die Ausbildung von Berufseinsteigerinnen und Berufseinsteigern, bilden Medienschaffende weiter und trainieren Kommunikationsverantwortliche und Führungskräfte.
Im Zuge der laufenden Organisationsentwicklung suchen wir eine engagierte und selbständige Persönlichkeit als
**Key Account Manager:in**
**Ihre Rolle**
Als Key Account Manager:in am MAZ bauen Sie unsere aktive Kundenakquise insbesondere für massgeschneiderte Angebote auf und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter. Sie identifizieren neue Kund:innen und Marktbedürfnisse und bauen langfristige Beziehungen auf. Von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Offerte bis zum Abschluss sorgen Sie dafür, dass aus Kundenbedürfnissen konkrete Aufträge werden.
**Ihre Verantwortung**
* **Marktbearbeitung:** Sie sprechen Unternehmen, Verwaltungen, öffentliche Institutionen, staatsnahe Betriebe, Verbände, Non\-Profit\-Organisationen, Kommunikationsabteilungen und Medienhäuser aktiv an und gewinnen neue Kund:innen.
* **Kund:innenentwicklung:** Sie identifizieren und qualifizieren Leads, führen Erst\- und Bedarfsgespräche und bauen, in enger Abstimmung mit der CEO, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.
* **Angebotsentwicklung:** Sie übersetzen Kundenbedürfnisse gemeinsam mit unserem Chief Product Officer (CPO) und Studienleitungen in passende Weiterbildungsangebote.
* **Offerten \& Abschlüsse:** Sie erstellen und kalkulieren Offerten, fassen systematisch nach und gewinnen neue Aufträge und Wiederholungsaufträge.
* **Sales\-Funnel \& CRM:** Sie bauen einen professionellen Sales\-Funnel auf, pflegen Kund:innendaten und sorgen für klare und verbindliche Nachfassprozesse.
* **Marktfeedback:** Sie bringen Erkenntnisse aus Kund:innengesprächen ins MAZ zurück und liefern damit wichtige Impulse für die Weiterentwicklung und Positionierung unserer Angebote.
* **Kundenbetreuung:** Sie begleiten die Kund:innen vom Erstkontakt bis zur Übergabe an CPO, Studienleitungen und Administration und sorgen für eine konsistente Kundenerfahrung.
**Das bringen Sie mit**
**1\. Verkauf \& Kundenentwicklung**
* **B2B\-Erfahrung:** Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B\-Verkauf, Business Development, Key Account Management oder in der beratungsnahen Kund:innenentwicklung, idealerweise in der Medien\- und Kommunikationsbranche.
* **Beratungskompetenz:** Sie erkennen Kundenbedürfnisse, strukturieren diese und entwickeln daraus gemeinsam mit unseren Fachpersonen konkrete Lösungen.
* **Beziehungsmanagement:** Sie wissen, wie langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut, gepflegt und weiterentwickelt werden.
* **Abschlussstärke:** Sie haben Freude an aktiver Marktbearbeitung, verfolgen Offerten konsequent und orientieren sich an messbaren Ergebnissen.
**2\. Markt\- \& Angebotsverständnis**
* **Weiterbildung \& Kommunikation:** Sie interessieren sich für Themen wie Journalismus, Kommunikation, KI, Medienkompetenz, Auftrittskompetenz und Weiterbildung.
* **Konzeptionelles Denken:** Sie können Kund:innenbedürfnisse in passgenaue Angebote übersetzen und arbeiten dafür eng mit internen Fachpersonen zusammen.
* **Sales\-Prozesse:** Erfahrung mit CRM, Sales\-Funnel, Pipeline\-Steuerung und systematischer Angebotsnachfassung ist von Vorteil.
* **Kommunikation:** Sie kommunizieren schriftlich und mündlich stilsicher und erstellen überzeugende Offerten, Angebotsunterlagen und Kundenkorrespondenz.
**3\. Persönlichkeit**
* **Kund:innenorientierung:** Sie haben ein ausgeprägtes Dienstleistungsverständnis und treten gegenüber Geschäftsleitungen, HR, Kommunikationsverantwortlichen und öffentlichen Institutionen souverän auf.
* **Unternehmerisches Denken:** Sie erkennen Chancen, gehen aktiv auf potenzielle Kunden zu und haben Freude daran, neue Märkte zu entwickeln.
* **Verbindlichkeit:** Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert und beharrlich und behalten Ihre Pipeline im Blick.
* **Teamorientierung:** Sie arbeiten eng mit der CEO, CPO, Studienleitungen, Marketing, Administration und weiteren Fachpersonen zusammen und verstehen Verkauf als gemeinsame Aufgabe.
**Das bieten wir Ihnen**
* Die Möglichkeit, die Marktbearbeitung des MAZ aktiv mit aufzubauen und zu professionalisieren.
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum an der Schnittstelle von Verkauf, Weiterbildung, Journalismus und Kommunikation.
* Ein breites Netzwerk aus Medien, Unternehmen, Verwaltungen und öffentlichen Institutionen.
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung, Marketing sowie unseren Studienleitungen und ausgewiesenen Fachpersonen.
* Einen Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von Luzern sowie regelmässigen direkten Kontakt mit Kund:innen in der Deutschschweiz und künftig schweizweit.

Account Executive «Data \& Analytics» (a) 80% \- 100% in Zürich
==================================================================
Abacus ist fast schon das Microsoft der Schweiz. Über 60’000 KMU setzen auf die ERP\-Lösung aus St. Gallen – und immer mehr davon auch auf integrierte Data\- \& Analytics\-Lösungen, um Transparenz, Steuerung und Effizienz zu erhöhen. AXEPT gehört zu den führenden Abacus\-Partnern und unterstützt Kunden dabei, ihre Daten gezielt nutzbar zu machen. Unser Data\-\&\-Analytics\-Bereich wächst stark – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.
**Das macht deinen Alltag spannend:**
* Gewinnung neuer Kunden und Projekte im Bereich Data\-, Reporting\- und Analytics\-Lösungen rund um Abacus und andere Lösungen
* Identifikation, Qualifizierung und Priorisierung von Leads sowie eigenständiger Aufbau und Pflege der Sales\-Pipeline
* Ganzheitliche Steuerung des Vertriebsprozesses von der Erstansprache über Präsentationen und Angebotsverhandlungen bis zum Abschluss
* Analyse der Kundenanforderungen im Bereich Reporting, Controlling und Analytics und Entwicklung passender Lösungskonzepte
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams wie D\&A\-Team, Sales\-Team, Projects, Product \& Innovation sowie Backoffice zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
* Beobachtung von Markt\- und Technologietrends im Bereich Data \& Analytics und aktive Weitergabe im Sales\-Team
**Das bringst du mit:**
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management, Consulting oder Lösungsverkauf – idealerweise im Data\-, Analytics\- oder Software\-Umfeld
* Freude an aktiver Neukundenakquisition und am Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
* Ein gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, KPIs und Reporting\-Anforderungen
* Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe Daten\-Themen verständlich zu erklären
* Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten
* Unternehmerisches Denken und den Anspruch, deine Umsatzziele eigenständig zu erreichen
* Starkes Interesse an Data, Analytics, BI und Digitalisierung
* Kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung – kombiniert mit Erfahrung in Beratung oder Verkauf
* Kenntnisse von Abacus, BI\-Tools oder Reporting\-Lösungen sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss
**Und das hast du dann davon:**
* Einen anspruchsvollen, aber superspannenden Job, in den wir dich vor Ort gut einarbeiten. Und wenn du sattelfest bist, gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
* Es ist uns ein wenig peinlich, uns für den vermutlich besten Teamspirit weit und breit selber zu rühmen. Darum zitieren wir hier einfach ein fünf Sterne\-Feedback von Kununu: «Teamspirit wird geschrieben». Stimmt!
* Von null auf hundert in 19… nein, nicht Sekunden, Jahren. Wir sind , aber gesund gewachsen und gut organisiert. Doch etwas ist noch wie in unseren Anfängen: Die Strukturen sind schlank und du findest die richtigen Ansprechpartner leicht.
* In unserem Bereich gehören wir zu den grösseren Playern und sind bekannt für unsere hohe Qualität. Kein Wunder, werden wir immer wieder als herausragend guter Umsetzungspartner ausgezeichnet.
* Einen guten Lohn, den du mit deiner Leistung mitbestimmen kannst. Krankentaggeld\- und Unfallversicherung? Übernehmen wir. Zusammen mit anderen Benefits macht das einmal ein paar Tausender im Jahr aus.
**Schon Feuer gefangen?** Du willst lieber heute als morgen loslegen? Dann uns dein CV oder den Link zu deinem LinkedIn\-Profil. Das Motivationsschreiben kannst du dir sparen, wir sind auch da völlig unkompliziert.
**Und das (a) im Stellentitel?** Es ist unser Statement für Vielfalt. Wir stehen auf durchmischte Teams. Alter, Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Geschlecht oder Lebensentwurf sind uns egal. Bei uns sind **(a)**lle willkommen, die uns mit ihrem Talent weiterbringen.

The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Senior Business Development Manager, Control Tower to drive pipeline, award conversion, and revenue growth for Flexport’s Control Tower business across our Central region. This role will sit in Chicago, with the flexibility to travel to customers across the territory when it matters (up to 25% travel).
Flexport’s Control Tower gives customers one system to manage order management, booking management, buyer’s consolidation, and supply chain optimization. You’ll be the Control Tower subject matter expert (SME) embedded in the sales process – partnering with Account Executives and sales leadership to run customer conversations, shape the right solution, demo the technology, and price deals to win without giving away margin.
This is a consultative, value-based sell with a longer cycle than a typical transactional deal. You’ll need to get genuinely fluent in a prospect’s current supply chain, systems, and headcount so you can build a credible business case for why Control Tower is worth the switch – and defend that case on price.

Owning Central region growth – driving customer count, Control Tower volume, and profitability across your sales regions.
Partnering with Account Executives – joining customer calls, coaching deal strategy, and serving as the Control Tower expert throughout the sales cycle.
Solutioning around the customer’s supply chain – understanding their current workflows, systems, and staffing well enough to design the right order management, booking management, buyer’s consolidation, or supply chain optimization fit.
Building the ROI case – using the customer’s current software costs, headcount, and process data to quantify savings and prove out the value of switching to Flexport.
Pricing to win, and to protect margin – leading commercial strategy on Control Tower deals so the business we close is profitable for Flexport, not just fast to sign.
Demoing the technology – showing AEs and prospects how Control Tower works and why it’s differentiated from point solutions and manual processes.
Translating contracts to operational SOPs - assist with SOP generation and implementation for solutions you create and deals you close.
Converting awards into attainment – staying engaged after the deal closes so awarded volume actually ships, protecting attainment against the original award.

6+ years of quota-carrying sales or business development related experience, ideally in supply chain, logistics, or supply chain software.
Consultative selling experience – comfortable running a longer, value-based sales cycle rather than a transactional one.
Working knowledge of supply chain operations – order management, booking and vendor management, buyer’s consolidation, and how shippers manage inbound freight today.
ROI and business case fluency – able to turn a customer’s current-state costs and workflows into a quantified savings story.
Strong presence with both AEs and customers – you’ll coach sales teams internally and pitch technology directly to prospects and executives.
Location and travel – based in Chicago, IL preferred, with the flexibility to travel up to 25% to customers across the Midwest and South.
Bachelor’s degree; MBA or equivalent operating experience welcome.

Control Tower is one of Flexport’s fastest-growing product lines, and this role owns a region full of the manufacturers, retailers, and distributors that need a better way to manage bookings, consolidate orders, and run their supply chain. You’ll set the playbook for how Flexport wins Control Tower business across the Central regions – working side by side with AEs to turn pipeline into awards, and awards into customers who stick around and grow.

On-target earnings (OTE) represent the total potential income an employee can earn by achieving 100% of their performance goals. It combines a base salary with commissions and serves as an estimated figure rather than a guaranteed amount, providing a guideline based on average performance outcomes.

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.
The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!
For more information, visit www.natera.com .
Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.
All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.
If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.
Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/
Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @ natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent.

Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.
Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.
While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.
We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.
Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Strategic Account Executive is a field-based position with ownership of an assigned territory focused on net new logo and upsell opportunities. You will have the ability to utilize a robust internal resource model, a broad tech stack, and a global partner directory to position yourself for future success.

Create, implement, measure and review a personal plan that drives achievement of performance goals aligned to the regional sales strategy.

Negotiate and close complex contracts with the support of global partners.
Report on sales activity and forecasts to senior management.
Prepare indicative subscription pricing and customer offers, including reviewing broader opportunities such as training and professional services modules, and guides request for proposal responses.
Provides customer feedback to marketing, customer success, product management, and engineering teams.
Work collaboratively to acquire additional/specialist resources as needed.

Significant quota-carrying experience selling enterprise software solutions.
Proven ability to win net new business.
Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota within the market.
Sustainable record of signing strategic and large projects, with long and complex sales cycles.
Established sector-related C level contacts.
Successful record dealing with strategic buyers.
Deep knowledge of the relevant key drivers of change in the industry.
Background working with regional/national/global partners and system integrators.
Prior training and experience in value selling and account planning methodologies.
Eligibility to work in Belgium

You have a great personality, strong drive and natural leadership skills! You inspire others, lead from the front and know how to win business through a personal, tailored approach. As our Cluster Sales Manager for London, you will take ownership of our sales strategy in one of our most exciting growth markets.
Currently operating one hotel, we are expanding rapidly to four properties within the next 12 months and more in the pipeline. This is a unique opportunity to shape, build and lead a high-performing sales team while playing a key role in our continued success.

Planning, coordinating and executing all sales activities across the London portfolio, including client events, networking opportunities and hotel tours
Proactively acquiring new corporate clients (primarily by phone), leading contract negotiations and successfully closing agreements
Driving company-wide sales by positioning and selling Motel One to London-based companies, maximising cross-property opportunities as the portfolio expands
Building and maintaining strong relationships with existing corporate clients, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, retention and repeat business
Developing and implementing the London cluster sales strategy in line with overall company objectives
Supporting pre-opening sales activities and pipeline development for new hotel openings in London
Leading, coaching and developing a team of Sales Managers, building a high-performing and motivated sales culture
Preparing, analysing and interpreting sales reports, tracking client performance, overall performance across the London properties, and your team’s results
Identifying new business opportunities and driving revenue growth across multiple properties
Monitoring and analysing competitor activity and market trends to ensure a strong commercial position
Collaborating closely with hotel operations and senior leadership to align sales strategies with overall business objectives

A strong commercially aware sales leader with experience in hotel and / or multi-property hotel sales, ready to take on your first cluster role
Strong knowledge of the London market and proven ability to acquire new business and grow existing accounts
A proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to both lead and actively sell
Strong analytical skills and a results-driven mindset
Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills
A passion for hospitality and delivering exceptional customer experiences
